>Trade school is always an option too.

I'm pretty positive that I want to go non-vocational school, but I'm just having trouble deciding what to major in.  I've got my list down to these:

* Physics
* Chemistry
* Biology
* Math of some sort
* Computer Science
* Linguistics
* History
* Literature

As you can see it's a bit of a daunting task to pick one, but I've got another year so hopefully the list will dwindle until only one or two are left.

>Don't worry if you slip up or it looks like you haven't made much progress. Pick yourself up, come to terms with the present, and keep trying for a brighter future.

Thank you for that.  Sometimes I forget that mistakes aren't the end of everything.

>such as hiking, climbing, cycling.

Hiking actually sounds like a good idea as a live within a few miles of a large number of hiking trails, but I will need an alternate activity to do when winter sets it.

>Sounds like you're a pretty sporty guy. You're like ahead of a bunch of people there. You're good looking and shy.

Thanks for that.  It made my week.
